instruction.text: Fill in the numbers to complete the timeline.

feedback.finish: Between 1969 and 1972 there were 7 Apollo missions and 12 people walked on the Moon. Since then, nobody has landed on the Moon.

instruction.text: Why do you think nobody else has landed on the Moon?

feedback.finish: Exploring space costs lots of money. Many people think it is better to spend money helping people on Earth rather than going to space.
In 1998, NASA created the International Space Station. It is a big spacecraft that astronauts can live on, and it is constantly moving around the Earth.

atoms.b: Recently, there have been developments in ((++space ocean)) tourism. People who aren’t astronauts can now pay to go to space.
The trip lets you travel to space for 90 ((++minutes years)) but it costs lots and lots of ((++money beans)).

feedback.finish: In the future, space tourism could become more popular. Do you think you would like to go to space?
